note: ESTIMATED snapshots per full build (snapshotted stories x modes). Raised 92 -> 94 for DataTable: again one photographed matrix story over two modes. Its other five stories are behaviour and disable their snapshot. Raised 94 -> 100 for EmptyState, SplitButton and AvatarGroup: three components, one photographed matrix story each, two modes.
